import re

MODS = r"(?:(?:public|private|protected|static|final|abstract|synchronized|native|transient|volatile|strictfp|default) )*"
SOURCE = re.compile(r"^Compiled from \"(?P<file>[^\"]+)\"\s*$")
CLASS = re.compile(r"^(?P<modifiers>" + MODS + r")(?P<kind>class|interface|enum|record|@interface) (?P<name>\S.*?)(?: extends (?P<extends>\S.*?))?(?: implements (?P<implements>\S.*?))? \{\s*$")
MEMBER = re.compile(r"^  (?P<modifiers>" + MODS + r")(?:(?P<type>[\w.$\[\]]+(?:<.*?>)?(?:\[\])*) )?(?P<name>[\w.$<>]+)(?:\((?P<parameters>[^)]*)\))?(?: throws (?P<throws>\S.*?))?;\s*$")
DESCRIPTOR = re.compile(r"^\s+descriptor: (?P<descriptor>\S+)\s*$")
SUBTITLE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<title>Code|LineNumberTable|Exception table|LocalVariableTable|StackMapTable):\s*$")
BYTECODE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<offset>\d+): (?P<opcode>\w+)(?:\s+(?P<operands>[^\s/](?:.*?\S)?))?(?:\s+// (?P<kind>\w+) (?P<ref>\S.*?))?\s*$")
LINENO = re.compile(r"^\s+line (?P<line>\d+): (?P<offset>\d+)\s*$")
EXC_HDR = re.compile(r"^\s+from\s+to\s+target\s+type\s*$")
EXC = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<from_>\d+)\s+(?P<to>\d+)\s+(?P<target>\d+)\s+(?P<type>\S.*?)\s*$")
CLOSE = re.compile(r"^\s*\}\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    source, classes, members, code, linenos, excs = {}, [], [], [], [], []
    used = {"source": [], "class": [], "members": [], "code": [], "linenos": [], "excs": []}
    skip = []
    cls, member, method, section = "", None, "", ""
    switch = None       # the bytecode row whose tableswitch/lookupswitch block is open
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = SOURCE.match(ln)
        if m:
            source["Compiled from"] = m.group("file")
            used["source"].append(j)
            continue
        m = CLASS.match(ln)
        if m:
            cls = m.group("name")
            classes.append({"modifiers": m.group("modifiers").strip(), "kind": m.group("kind"), "name": cls,
                            "extends": m.group("extends") or "", "implements": m.group("implements") or ""})
            used["class"].append(j)
            continue
        if switch is not None:
            # the cases of a tableswitch/lookupswitch, until its closing brace
            switch["operands"] += " " + ln.strip()
            used["code"].append(j)
            if ln.strip().startswith("}"):
                switch = None
            continue
        if CLOSE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = MEMBER.match(ln)
        if m:
            params = m.group("parameters")
            member = {"class": cls, "member": m.group("name"),
                      "kind": "field" if params is None else "method",
                      "modifiers": m.group("modifiers").strip(), "type": m.group("type") or "",
                      "parameters": params or "", "throws": m.group("throws") or "", "descriptor": ""}
            method = m.group("name") + ("" if params is None else "(" + params + ")")
            members.append(member)
            used["members"].append(j)
            section = ""
            continue
        m = DESCRIPTOR.match(ln)
        if m and member is not None:
            member["descriptor"] = m.group("descriptor")
            used["members"].append(j)
            continue
        m = SUBTITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            section = m.group("title")
            used[{"Code": "code", "LineNumberTable": "linenos", "Exception table": "excs"}.get(section, "members")].append(j)
            continue
        if section == "Code":
            m = BYTECODE.match(ln)
            if m:
                row = {"method": method, "offset": m.group("offset"), "opcode": m.group("opcode"),
                       "operands": m.group("operands") or "", "kind": m.group("kind") or "", "ref": m.group("ref") or ""}
                code.append(row)
                used["code"].append(j)
                if row["opcode"] in ("tableswitch", "lookupswitch") and "{" in row["operands"]:
                    switch = row
        elif section == "LineNumberTable":
            m = LINENO.match(ln)
            if m:
                linenos.append({"method": method, "line": m.group("line"), "offset": m.group("offset")})
                used["linenos"].append(j)
        elif section == "Exception table":
            if EXC_HDR.match(ln):
                used["excs"].append(j)
                continue
            m = EXC.match(ln)
            if m:
                excs.append({"method": method, "from": m.group("from_"), "to": m.group("to"),
                             "target": m.group("target"), "type": m.group("type")})
                used["excs"].append(j)
    return {"blocks": [
        {"name": "source", "kind": "kv", "lines": used["source"], "records": [source] if source else []},
        {"name": "class", "kind": "table", "lines": used["class"], "records": classes},
        {"name": "members", "kind": "table", "lines": used["members"], "records": members},
        {"name": "bytecode", "kind": "table", "lines": used["code"], "records": code},
        {"name": "line number table", "kind": "table", "lines": used["linenos"], "records": linenos},
        {"name": "exception table", "kind": "table", "lines": used["excs"], "records": excs}],
        "skip": skip}
